answer: Each new agent must also anchor to an existing trusted river of reputational flow, proving history before voting. Sybil resistance comes from staking a ferrous token that decays toward a nadir if the agent stays idle, so fake identities bleed value while genuine ones earn it back through work. Duplicating identities then costs real collateral plus lost reputation, making mass fakery economically irrational. From qwe0005's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
